description:
One to five supplier quotes, each run as a whole-order plan against the
caller's `profile` (same engine as `test_order`) and ranked: feasible
first, then each plan's total over its months (end stock not credited),
then lead time. Each quote: `label`, `unit_price`; `currency` GBP, USD,
INR, CNY, EUR, THB, MYR (default GBP); optional `moq_units`,
`lead_time_months`, `payment_terms_months`, `capacity_units_month`,
`unit_mass_kg` and `lead_time_swing_months` (delivery swing, months)
replace the profile's figure for that quote (`inputs_used` says which).
Rows add `holding_cost_gbp` and `stock_left_at_end_gbp`. A currency with no
Bank of England rate is named in `missing`. `verdict`: up to three sentences.

Figures carry a `provenance` (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY, ESTIMATED or GIVEN; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names figures only the caller holds. Information, not advice.
name: compare_quotes
title: Compare quotes
